<!-- custom OAuth fields, shared by IMAP and POP3 -->
      <vbox id="oauth2CustomDetailsContainer">
        <separator class="groove" />
        <checkbox
          id="oauth2UseCustomDetails"
          amsa_persist="true"
          data-l10n-id="oauth2-use-custom-details"
          oncommand="onChangeOAuth2CustomDetails(this)"
        />
        <hbox class="indent">
          <!-- Labels -->
          <vbox>
            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <label
                id="oauth2ClientIdLabel"
                data-l10n-id="oauth2-client-id-label"
                control="oauth2ClientId"
              />
            </hbox>
            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <label
                id="oauth2AuthorizationEndpointLabel"
                data-l10n-id="oauth2-authorization-endpoint-label"
                control="oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint"
              />
            </hbox>
            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <label
                id="oauth2TokenEndpointLabel"
                data-l10n-id="oauth2-token-endpoint-label"
                control="oauth2TokenEndpoint"
              />
            </hbox>
            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <label
                id="oauth2ScopesLabel"
                data-l10n-id="oauth2-scopes-label"
                control="oauth2Scopes"
              />
            </hbox>
            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <label
                id="oauth2RedirectionEndpointLabel"
                data-l10n-id="oauth2-redirection-endpoint-label"
                control="oauth2RedirectionEndpoint"
              />
            </hbox>
          </vbox>
          <!-- Input Fields -->
          <vbox flex="1">
            <html:input
              id="oauth2ClientId"
              type="text"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="oauth2ClientIdLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
            />
            <html:input
              id="oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint"
              type="url"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="oauth2AuthorizationEndpointLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
            />
            <html:input
              id="oauth2TokenEndpoint"
              type="url"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="oauth2TokenEndpointLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
            />
            <html:input
              id="oauth2Scopes"
              type="text"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="oauth2ScopesLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
            />
            <html:input
              id="oauth2RedirectionEndpoint"
              type="url"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="oauth2RedirectionEndpointLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
              placeholder="http://localhost"
            />
          </vbox>
        </hbox>
        <vbox class="indent">
          <checkbox
            id="oauth2UsePKCE"
            amsa_persist="true"
            data-l10n-id="oauth2-use-pkce"
          />
          <checkbox
            id="oauth2UseExternalBrowser"
            amsa_persist="true"
            data-l10n-id="oauth2-use-system-browser"
          />
        </vbox>
